This code was used to generate _Figure 7C and Supplementary Figure 13H_

Data for spatial transcriptomics on triple negative breast cancers from Wang et al. 2024 is available on: https://zenodo.org/records/14204217

Download the data contained in the following folders. According to the authors:
In _byArray_ folder we will find the data by array/subarray. Mapping  
between those arrays and samples is in ids.RDS (Clinical directory).  
In each directory, there are the following files:
   -A *Cy3 jpg* file giving the location of the spots
   -An *HE jpg* file which is the H&E image
   -For both image, there can be a *.rot* version if it was necessary to rotate them for the analysis.
   -*spot_data...* give the localization of all or selected spots
   -*small.jpg* is a subsampled version of the image.
   - *selection.RData* counts of selected spots
   -*all.RData* counts of all spots
   -*allSpots.RData* position of all spots
   -*annotBySpot.RDS* if available, the annotation (in pixel) for each spot
   -*artefacts.RDS* if present, gives the number of pixels annotated  as an artefact in each spot

After dowload the data in your working directory, load the libraries required:
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)
library(biomaRt)
library(grid)
library(jpeg)
library(png)
library(tidyr)
```

Change the ENS name of each gene to GENE ID usign BioMart. This script will modify the name of each slide(sample) and create a new file called 'cnts_symbols'. ¡Only run this chunk for the first time!
```{r}
ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
base_path <- "/home/zdral/Documents/FernandoCalvo/ST_TNBC_WANG/byArray/"
#
Folders for each sample CN (CN1, CN2, ...)
cn_folders <- list.dirs(base_path, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
#
# Loop through each folder CN
for (cn in cn_folders) {
  # List each subfolder starting with C, D o E
  subfolders <- list.dirs(cn, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  subfolders <- subfolders[grepl("/[CDE][0-9]+$", subfolders)]

  for (sub in subfolders) {
    message("Processing folder: ", sub)

    cnts_file <- file.path(sub, "selection.RData")
    if (!file.exists(cnts_file)) {
      warning("File not found: ", cnts_file)
      next
    }

    # Load cnts
    load(cnts_file)

    # Verify if cnts exists
    if (!exists("cnts")) {
      warning("Object 'cnts' not defined: ", cnts_file)
      next
    }

    # Extract and clean IDs Ensembl
    ensembl_ids <- colnames(cnts)
    ensembl_ids_clean <- sub("\\..*", "", ensembl_ids)

    # Obtain mapping Ensembl → symbol
    mapping <- getBM(
      attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
      filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
      values = ensembl_ids_clean,
       mart = ensembl
    )

    # Create dictionary 
    dict <- setNames(mapping$hgnc_symbol, mapping$ensembl_gene_id)

    # Generate a new matrix after renaming the genes
    cnts_symbols <- cnts
    colnames(cnts_symbols) <- ifelse(dict[ensembl_ids_clean] == "" |  is.na(dict[ensembl_ids_clean]),
                                     ensembl_ids,
                                      dict[ensembl_ids_clean])

    # Save results
    save(cnts_symbols, file = file.path(sub, "cnts_symbols.RData"))
  }
}

# Note: No data files are available for sample CN35/D2; only the H&E slide is available
```

Get the *H&E* image for each patient in an unique pdf file 
```{r} 
base_path <- "/home/zdral/Documents/FernandoCalvo/ST_TNBC_WANG/byArray"

cn_folders <- list.dirs(base_path, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE) 

pdf(file.path(base_path, "HE_images_all_samples.pdf"), width = 8, height = 8)
  for (cn in cn_folders) {
    subfolders <- list.dirs(cn, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
   subfolders <- subfolders[grepl("/[CDE][0-9]+$", subfolders)]

   for (sub in subfolders) {#
     # Search files with "HE" in its name
     he_files <- list.files(sub, pattern = "^small\\.jpg$",  full.names = TRUE)

     if (length(he_files) == 0) {
       warning("No HE image found in: ", sub)
      next
     }
     for (f in he_files) {
       grid::grid.newpage()
       img <- jpeg::readJPEG(f)
       grid::grid.raster(img)
       title <- paste("Sample:", basename(dirname(sub)), "/", basename(sub), "\nArchivo:", basename(f))
       grid::grid.text(title, x = 0.5, y = 0.95, gp = gpar(fontsize =12, col = "blue"))
     }
  }
 }

dev.off()
```

Get the *annotation* image for each slide in an unique pdf file with the legend for each cell type. This is what we use as reference for cellular composition (annotation) of each ST slide.
```{r}
img_dir <-  "/home/zdral/Documents/FernandoCalvo/ST_TNBC_WANG/Images/imageAnnotations"

#List all PNG
img_files <- list.files(
   img_dir,
   pattern = "\\.png$",
   full.names = TRUE,
   ignore.case = TRUE
)

img_files <- sort(img_files)

#Cell type legend
colAnn2 <- c(
   "Nothing" = "#FFFFFF",
   "Tumor" = "#017801",
   "Necrosis" = "#000000",
   "Fat tissue" = "#000080",
   "Low TIL stroma" = "#ff904f",
   "Vessels" = "#dc0000",
   "Artefacts" = "#6e2400",
   "Lactiferous duct" = "#9980e6",
   "High TIL stroma" = "#e9e900",
   "in situ" = "#ccffcc",
   "Lymphoid nodule" = "#80801a",
   "Hole (whitespace)" = "#40e5f6",
   "Lymphocyte" = "#c4417f",
   "Stroma cell" = "#ff9980",
   "Nerve" = "#4d8080",
   "Heterologous elements" = "#808080",
   "Acellular stroma" = "#e9d1bb",
   "Tumor region" = "#258a15"
)

pdf_file <- file.path(
   img_dir,
   "Annotation_images_with_legend.pdf"
)

pdf(
   pdf_file,
   width = 11.69,   # A4 horizontal
   height = 8.27,
   onefile = TRUE
)
for (img_file in img_files) {

   sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
     basename(img_file)
   )

   img <- readPNG(img_file)

   img_width <- dim(img)[2]
   img_height <- dim(img)[1]

   aspect_ratio <- img_width / img_height
   grid.newpage()

   grid.text(
     sample_name,
     x = 0.5,
     y = 0.975,
     gp = gpar(
       fontsize = 14,
       fontface = "bold"
     )
   )

   pushViewport(
     viewport(
       x = 0.5,
       y = 0.60,
       width = 0.94,
       height = 0.68
     )
   )

# Keep original proportions
   grid.raster(
     img,
     interpolate = FALSE,
     just = "center"
   )

   popViewport()

# Legend for each image
   n_colors <- length(colAnn2)
   n_col <- 2
   n_row <- ceiling(n_colors / n_col)
   x_positions <- c(0.30, 0.70)
   legend_y_top <- 0.24
   legend_y_bottom <- 0.035

   y_positions <- seq(
     legend_y_top,
     legend_y_bottom,
     length.out = n_row
   )
   grid.text(
     "Annotation",
     x = 0.5,
     y = 0.285,
     gp = gpar(
       fontsize = 11,
       fontface = "bold"
     )
   )

   for (i in seq_along(colAnn2)) {

     col_idx <- ifelse(i <= n_row, 1, 2)

     row_idx <- ifelse(
       i <= n_row,
       i,
       i - n_row
     )

     x <- x_positions[col_idx]
     y <- y_positions[row_idx]

     grid.rect(
       x = x,
       y = y,
       width = 0.025,
       height = 0.025,
       gp = gpar(
         fill = colAnn2[i],
         col = "grey30",
         lwd = 0.5
       )
     )

          grid.text(
       names(colAnn2)[i],
       x = x + 0.02,
       y = y,
       just = "left",
       gp = gpar(
         fontsize = 8.5
       )
     )
   }
}

dev.off()
```

Get the *fraction for main cell types* (tumor, stroma, lymphoid, artifact). Only use samples with "annotBySpot.RDS" 
```{r}
base_path <- "/home/zdral/Documents/FernandoCalvo/ST_TNBC_WANG/byArray"
results_dir <- "/home/zdral/Documents/FernandoCalvo/ST_TNBC_WANG/results"

dir.create(
   results_dir,
   recursive = TRUE,
   showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Define new groups:
annotation_groups <- list(

   "Artifact" = c("Artefacts","Hole (whitespace)","in situ","Necrosis","Nothing","Heterologous elements"),

   "Stroma" = c("Acellular stroma","Fat tissue","High TIL  
stroma","Lactiferous duct","Low TIL stroma","Stroma  
cell","Vessels","Nerve"),

   "Lymphoid" = c("Lymphocyte", "Lymphoid nodule"),

   "Tumor" = c("Tumor","Tumor region")
)


cn_folders <- list.dirs(base_path,full.names = TRUE,recursive = FALSE)

sample_folders <- unlist(
   lapply(
     cn_folders,

     function(cn) {

       subfolders <- list.dirs(
         cn,
         full.names = TRUE,
         recursive = FALSE
       )

       subfolders <- subfolders[
         grepl(
           "/[CDE][0-9]+$",
           subfolders
         )
       ]
       subfolders <- subfolders[
         file.exists(
           file.path(
             subfolders,
             "annotBySpot.RDS"  #Select samples only with annotBySpot.RDS
           )
         )
       ]

       return(subfolders)
     }
   )
)


if (length(sample_folders) == 0) {

   stop(
     "No samples with annotBySpot.RDS found."
   )
}

all_fractions <- list()

for (sub in sample_folders) {
   sample_id <- paste(
     basename(dirname(sub)),
     basename(sub),
     sep = "/"
   )

   annot_file <- file.path(
     sub,
     "annotBySpot.RDS" #Nº of pixel for each annotation
   )

   annotBySpot <- readRDS(annot_file)
   annotBySpot <- as.data.frame(annotBySpot)
   available_annotations <- colnames(annotBySpot)

   grouped_counts <- matrix(
     0,
     nrow = nrow(annotBySpot),
     ncol = length(annotation_groups)
   )

   colnames(grouped_counts) <- names(annotation_groups)
   rownames(grouped_counts) <- rownames(annotBySpot)

  # Compute the sum of the annotations associated with each group
   for (group_name in names(annotation_groups)) {

     annotations <- annotation_groups[[group_name]]
     annotations_present <- intersect(
       annotations,
       available_annotations
     )

     if (length(annotations_present) > 0) {

       grouped_counts[, group_name] <-
         rowSums(
           annotBySpot[, annotations_present, drop = FALSE],
           na.rm = TRUE
         )
     }
   }

# Save the annotations grouped
   annotBySpot_grouped <- as.data.frame(grouped_counts, check.names = FALSE)

# Get total pixels per spot
   total_pixels <- rowSums(
     annotBySpot_grouped,
     na.rm = TRUE
   )

# Get fraction 0-1
   fractions <- annotBySpot_grouped
   fractions[,] <- NA_real_

   valid_spots <- total_pixels > 0

   fractions[valid_spots, ] <-
     annotBySpot_grouped[valid_spots, ] /
     total_pixels[valid_spots]

   fractions <- data.frame(
     sample_id = sample_id,
     spot = rownames(fractions),
     fractions,
     total_pixels = total_pixels,
     row.names = NULL,
     check.names = FALSE
   )

# Save results
   sample_dir <- file.path(results_dir,gsub("/", "_", sample_id))
   dir.create(sample_dir,recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

   saveRDS( annotBySpot_grouped,  
file.path(sample_dir,"annotBySpot_grouped.RDS"))

   saveRDS(fractions,file.path(sample_dir,"annotFractionsBySpot.RDS"))

# Create a CSV file
write.csv(fractions,file.path(sample_dir,"annotFractionsBySpot.csv"),  
row.names = FALSE)

   all_fractions[[sample_id]] <- fractions
}


fractions_all <- do.call(rbind,all_fractions)
rownames(fractions_all) <- NULL

saveRDS(fractions_all,  
file.path(results_dir,"annotFractionsBySpot_ALL_SAMPLES.RDS"))

write.csv(fractions_all,  
file.path(results_dir,"annotFractionsBySpot_ALL_SAMPLES.csv"),row.names =  
FALSE)
```

*Represent each cellular fraction* in each patient slide using a colorimetric scale
```{r}
base_path <- "/home/zdral/Documents/FernandoCalvo/ST_TNBC_WANG/byArray"
results_dir <- "/home/zdral/Documents/FernandoCalvo/ST_TNBC_WANG/results"

output_pdf <- file.path(results_dir,"Tumor_fraction_all_samples.pdf") #Change name for cellular fraction of interest

cn_folders <- list.dirs(base_path,full.names = TRUE,recursive = FALSE)

sample_folders <- unlist(lapply(cn_folders,

     function(cn) {

       subfolders <- list.dirs(
         cn,
         full.names = TRUE,
         recursive = FALSE
       )

       subfolders <- subfolders[
         grepl(
           "/[CDE][0-9]+$",
           subfolders
         )
       ]

             subfolders <- subfolders[
         file.exists(
           file.path(
             subfolders,
             "selectionSpots.RDS"
           )
         )
       ]

       return(subfolders)
     }
   )
)

pdf(output_pdf,width = 7,height = 7)


for (sub in sample_folders) {

   sample_id <- paste(
     basename(dirname(sub)),
     basename(sub),
     sep = "/"
   )

   selectionSpots <- readRDS(file.path(
       sub,
       "selectionSpots.RDS"
     )
   )

   sample_results_dir <- file.path(
     results_dir,
     gsub(
       "/",
       "_",
       sample_id
     )
   )

   fractions_file <-  
file.path(sample_results_dir,"annotFractionsBySpot.RDS") #This file contains the fraction (0-1) of each main cell type annotation per spot

   if (!file.exists(fractions_file)) {

     warning(
       "No annotFractionsBySpot.RDS found for: ",
       sample_id
     )

     next
   }

   fractions <- readRDS(fractions_file)
   common_spots <- intersect(rownames(selectionSpots),fractions$spot)

   if (length(common_spots) == 0) {

     warning(
       "No common spots in: ",
       sample_id
     )

     next
   }


   plotData <- selectionSpots[
     common_spots,
     ,
     drop = FALSE
   ]


   Tumor_fraction <- fractions$Tumor[ #Change name for cell fraction of interest
     match(
       common_spots,
       fractions$spot
     )
   ]

   plotData$Tumor_fraction <- Tumor_fraction #Change name for cell  fraction of interest

# Genrate the plot
   p <- ggplot(
     plotData,
     aes(
       x = pixel_x,
       y = pixel_y,
       color = Tumor_fraction #Change name for cell fraction of interest
     )
   ) +

     geom_point(
       size = 2
     ) +

     scale_color_distiller(
   palette = "RdYlBu",
   direction = -1,
   limits = c(0, 1),
       name = "Tumor_fraction", #Change name for cell fraction of interest
       na.value = "grey80"
     ) +

     coord_fixed() +
     scale_y_reverse() +
     theme(
       legend.position = "right",
       panel.grid = element_blank(),
       panel.background = element_blank(),
       axis.ticks = element_blank(),
       axis.text = element_blank(),
       axis.title = element_blank()
     ) +

     labs(title = paste("Tumor_fraction -",sample_id) #Change name for cell fraction of interest
)

   print(p)
}

dev.off()
```

Generate a .csv file with the *fraction of different annotation types (stroma, tumor...) per patient*. In each sample, pixels belonging to the same cell fraction were summed across all spots, and the overall fraction was subsequently calculated.
```{r}
base_path <- "/home/zdral/Documents/FernandoCalvo/ST_TNBC_WANG/byArray"
results_dir <- "/home/zdral/Documents/FernandoCalvo/ST_TNBC_WANG/results"

output_csv <- file.path(results_dir,"pixel_fractions_per_sample.csv")

cn_folders <- list.dirs(base_path,full.names = TRUE,recursive = FALSE)

sample_folders <- unlist(
   lapply(
     cn_folders,

     function(cn) {

       subfolders <- list.dirs(
         cn,
         full.names = TRUE,
         recursive = FALSE
       )

       subfolders <- subfolders[
         grepl(
           "/[CDE][0-9]+$",
           subfolders
         )
       ]

       subfolders <- subfolders[
         file.exists(
           file.path(
             subfolders,
             "selectionSpots.RDS"
           )
         )
       ]

       return(subfolders)
     }
   )
)


all_results <- list()
for (sub in sample_folders) {

   sample_id <- paste(
     basename(dirname(sub)),
     basename(sub),
     sep = "/"
   )

   sample_results_dir <- file.path(
     results_dir,
     gsub(
       "/",
       "_",
       sample_id
     )
   )

   grouped_file <- file.path(sample_results_dir,"annotBySpot_grouped.RDS")


   if (!file.exists(grouped_file)) {

     warning(
       "No annotBySpot_grouped.RDS found for: ",
       sample_id
     )

     next
   }

   annotBySpot_grouped <- readRDS(grouped_file)
   annotBySpot_grouped <- as.data.frame(annotBySpot_grouped)

   # Sum all pixels from all spots
   pixel_totals <- colSums(annotBySpot_grouped,na.rm = TRUE)
   total_pixels <- sum(pixel_totals, na.rm = TRUE)

   if (total_pixels == 0) {

     warning(
       "Total pixels = 0 for: ",
       sample_id
     )

     next
   }

# Get fractions
   pixel_fractions <- pixel_totals / total_pixels

   sample_result <- as.data.frame(t(pixel_fractions),check.names = FALSE)
   sample_result <- cbind(Sample = sample_id,sample_result)
   all_results[[sample_id]] <- sample_result
}

results_df <- bind_rows(all_results)
write.csv(results_df, output_csv,row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
cn_folders <- list.dirs(
   base_path,
   full.names = TRUE,
   recursive = FALSE
)

sample_folders <- unlist(

   lapply(

     cn_folders,

     function(cn) {

       subfolders <- list.dirs(
         cn,
         full.names = TRUE,
         recursive = FALSE

# Identify the signature genes that are available in all samples.

genes_per_sample <- list()

for (sub in sample_folders) {

   cnts_file <- file.path(
     sub,
     "cnts_symbols.RData"
   )


   if (exists("cnts_symbols")) {
     rm(cnts_symbols)
   }

   load(cnts_file)

   if (!exists("cnts_symbols")) {
     next
   }

   common_genes <- intersect(
     signature_genes,
     colnames(cnts_symbols)
   )

   genes_per_sample[[sub]] <- common_genes

}


if (length(genes_per_sample) == 0) {

   stop("Expression matrices could not be loaded."
   )

}

# Select only genes present in ALL samples

analysis_genes <- Reduce(intersect,genes_per_sample)

if (length(analysis_genes) == 0) {

   stop(
     "None of the signature genes were detected across all samples"
   )

}

# Calculate global gene expression to select control genes.
global_gene_sum <- NULL
global_gene_n <- NULL

for (sub in sample_folders) {

   cnts_file <- file.path(
     sub,
     "cnts_symbols.RData"
   )

   if (exists("cnts_symbols")) {
     rm(cnts_symbols)
   }

   load(cnts_file)
   
   expr <- as.matrix(
     cnts_symbols
   )

   total_counts <- rowSums(expr, na.rm = TRUE)

   valid <- total_counts > 0

   if (!any(valid)) {
     next
   }

   expr <- expr[
     valid,
     ,
     drop = FALSE
   ]


   total_counts <- total_counts[
     valid
   ]

# Normalization CP10K + LOG1P
   expr_log <- log1p(

     sweep(
       expr,
       1,
       total_counts,
       "/"
     ) * 10000

   )

   # Sum and number of observations per gene
   gene_sum <- colSums(
     expr_log,
     na.rm = TRUE
   )

   gene_n <- colSums(
     !is.na(expr_log)
   )


   if (is.null(global_gene_sum)) {

     global_gene_sum <- gene_sum
     global_gene_n <- gene_n

   } else {

     common_genes <- intersect(
       names(global_gene_sum),
       names(gene_sum)
     )

     global_gene_sum[
       common_genes
     ] <-

       global_gene_sum[
         common_genes
       ] +

       gene_sum[
         common_genes
       ]


     global_gene_n[
       common_genes
     ] <-

       global_gene_n[
         common_genes
       ] +

       gene_n[
         common_genes
       ]

   }

}

global_gene_mean <- global_gene_sum / global_gene_n

# Select control genes

control_candidates <- setdiff(names(global_gene_mean), analysis_genes)
control_genes <- character(0)

n_control_per_gene <- 5

for (g in analysis_genes) {

   if (!g %in% names(global_gene_mean)) {
     next
   }

   target_mean <- global_gene_mean[g]
   
   candidates <- control_candidates[

     !is.na(
       global_gene_mean[
         control_candidates
       ]
     )

   ]

   distances <- abs(

     global_gene_mean[
       candidates
     ] -

       target_mean

   )

   nearest <- names(

     sort(
       distances
     )

   )[

     seq_len(

       min(
         n_control_per_gene,
         length(distances)
       )

     )

   ]

   control_genes <- c(
     control_genes,
     nearest
   )

}

control_genes <- unique(
   control_genes
)


# Create a PDF file

output_pdf <- file.path(results_dir,paste0(signature_name, "_spatial_module_zscore_all_samples.pdf"))

pdf(output_pdf, width = 7, height = 7)

# Process all samples

for (sub in sample_folders) {

   CN <- basename(
     dirname(sub)
   )
   
   array <- basename(
     sub
   )

   sample_id <- paste(
     CN,
     array,
     sep = "_"
   )

   cnts_file <- file.path(
     sub,
     "cnts_symbols.RData"
   )


   if (exists("cnts_symbols")) {
     rm(cnts_symbols)
   }


   load(cnts_file)
   expr <- as.matrix(cnts_symbols)
   
   spots_file <- file.path(sub,"selectionSpots.RDS")

   selectionSpots <- readRDS(spots_file)

   annot_file <- file.path(sub,"annotBySpot_red.RDS")

   annotBySpot_red <- readRDS(annot_file)

   
# Match spots present in both the expression data and the spatial coordinates.

   common_spots <- intersect(rownames(expr),rownames(selectionSpots))

   if (length(common_spots) == 0) {

     warning(
       "No common spots in: ",
       sample_id
     )

     next
   }

   expr <- expr[

     common_spots,
     ,
     drop = FALSE

   ]


   selectionSpots <- selectionSpots[

     common_spots,
     ,
     drop = FALSE

   ]

# Normalization CP10K + LOG1P

   total_counts <- rowSums(
     expr,
     na.rm = TRUE
   )

   valid_spots <- total_counts > 0

   if (!any(valid_spots)) {

     warning(
       "No valid spots in: ",
       sample_id
     )

     next
   }


   expr <- expr[

     valid_spots,
     ,
     drop = FALSE

   ]


   selectionSpots <- selectionSpots[

     valid_spots,
     ,
     drop = FALSE

   ]


   total_counts <- total_counts[
     valid_spots
   ]

   # CP10K + LOG1P

   expr_log <- log1p(

     sweep(
       expr,
       1,
       total_counts,
       "/"
     ) * 10000

   )

   # Genes of the signature available

   sample_signature_genes <- intersect(

     analysis_genes,

     colnames(expr_log)

   )


   sample_control_genes <- intersect(

     control_genes,

     colnames(expr_log)

   )


   if (length(sample_signature_genes) == 0) {

     warning(
       "No available genes in: ",
       sample_id
     )

     next
   }

   # SIGNATURE SCORE
   
   signature_score <- rowMeans(

     expr_log[
       ,
       sample_signature_genes,
       drop = FALSE
     ],

     na.rm = TRUE

   )

   # CONTROL SCORE

   if (length(sample_control_genes) > 0) {

     control_score <- rowMeans(

       expr_log[
         ,
         sample_control_genes,
         drop = FALSE
       ],

       na.rm = TRUE

     )


   } else {


     control_score <- rep(

       0,

       nrow(expr_log)

     )

   }

   # MODULE SCORE

   module_score <- signature_score - control_score

   # MODULE Z-SCORE

   module_sd <- sd(module_score,na.rm = TRUE)

   if (

     is.na(module_sd) ||
     module_sd == 0

   ) {

     module_zscore <- rep(

       NA_real_,

       length(module_score)

     )


   } else {

     module_zscore <- as.numeric(

       scale(
         module_score
       )

     )

   }


# Generate plots 
   plotData <- as.data.frame(selectionSpots)
   plotData$module_zscore <- module_zscore
   
   p <- ggplot(

     plotData,

     aes(

       x = pixel_x,

       y = pixel_y,

       color = module_zscore

     )

   ) +


     geom_point(

       size = 2

     ) +

     scale_color_gradient2(

       low = "#2166AC",

       mid = "white",

       high = "#B2182B",

       midpoint = 0,

       limits = c(
         -4,
         4
       ),

       oob = scales::squish,

       breaks = c(
         -4,
         -2,
         0,
         2,
         4
       ),

       name = "Module\nz-score",

       na.value = "grey80"

     ) +

     coord_fixed() +
     scale_y_reverse() +
     theme_minimal(
       base_size = 12
     ) +

     theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
     labs(title = sample_id)

   print(p)

}

dev.off()
```
